neuralScope: Four agents, four recurrent steps each; neural computation and feature extraction. Excludes action readout, process messaging, RPC, transactions and cadence wait.
cycleScope: Recorded local application cycles, including RPC, transactions and outcome updates; excludes the following cadence wait. Not public-chain finality.
rssScope: Python process lifetime peak RSS, shared graph plus independent states; excludes Node, browser, Anvil, OS and preprocessing.

arithmetic.note: Arithmetic only; excludes graph, workspace, activations, KV cache, quantization metadata and other overhead. Not a measured hardware minimum or an equal-capability comparison.
